value_phase.scope: Auxiliary phase every eight committed iterations with uniform age weights. GAE retains PPO work evidence plus auxiliary KL safeguards; current-only holdout gates never recount older games.

heldout_unknown.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

buffer.scope: Eight trainable ages; pre-commit disk peak includes the not-yet-expired ninth cache. Mmap features; bounded minibatch transfers; no historical PPO admission.

split.scope: Outcome-independent hash ranking within table type; complete games excluded from all critic fits and caches; actor still uses these games. Rare strata oversampled in held-out diagnostics.

critic_training.scope: Retained PPO steps with nonempty critic batches and positive value_weight; calibration and PPG excluded

weight_recovery.scope: Ordinary held-out learner rows only; row-pooled MSE includes bias. Twenty committed iterations, ten qualifying; five new consecutive healthy commits, not independent overlapping windows. New weight stages start empty; reference never lowered on deterioration.

critic_rollout.scope: Snapshot weight uses frozen-reference rolling R2; descriptor admission and GAE EV gates unchanged

heldout_before.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

value_phase.weighting_scope: Each eligible critic row once per epoch; all eight age weights are 1. Policy strata are population-corrected once; existing snapshot critic loss weight is retained.

rate_schedule.scope: Linear warmup over the first acceptance interval, then linear decay to 0.3x at the planned epoch cap; retries reuse their original planned-step rate.

heldout_after.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

heldout_unknown.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

value_phase.memory_scope: Peak sampled phase RSS, OS process-lifetime RSS high-water, and CUDA allocator high-water; disk peak reported separately

buffer.scope: Eight trainable ages; pre-commit disk peak includes the not-yet-expired ninth cache. Mmap features; bounded minibatch transfers; no historical PPO admission.

split.scope: Outcome-independent hash ranking within table type; complete games excluded from all critic fits and caches; actor still uses these games. Rare strata oversampled in held-out diagnostics.

epoch_controller.scope: Best state position in the planned budget, excluding retry work. Three of four scheduled phases at the same cap; wait iterations are not evidence. Window resets after a cap change. KL-limited phases request beta pressure and cast no epoch vote. Bounds 1–6.

critic_training.scope: Retained PPO steps with nonempty critic batches and positive value_weight; calibration and PPG excluded

weight_recovery.scope: Ordinary held-out learner rows only; row-pooled MSE includes bias. Twenty committed iterations, ten qualifying; five new consecutive healthy commits, not independent overlapping windows. New weight stages start empty; reference never lowered on deterioration.

critic_rollout.scope: Snapshot weight uses frozen-reference rolling R2; descriptor admission and GAE EV gates unchanged

learner.normalization: Family groups sum to 1 per observed era; industry groups conditional on build; empty groups are zero
